divergences: The probe example is a named reconstruction choice: the retained example at row ordinal 0 of the pinned Parquet, selected before any activation was observed and independent of any feature or concept.

The v2 generation core renders the pinned template with add_generation_prompt and strips the trailing <think> reasoning opener, per the Issue 23 decision; this is a named departure from the template as published. Because the stripped prompt is the natural prefix of the template-rendered assistant turn, the supplied response is observed in the context it was written for, and the stripped prompt plus supplied response is verified fail-closed to be a genuine prefix of that assistant-turn rendering. The v1 same-generation-context placement is retired for this condition.

The published base response is stored as decoded text with special tokens removed, so its completion tokens are recovered by re-encoding. Exact detokenize-retokenize round-trip is not a guarantee of the pinned tokenizer; the recovered and recorded completion token counts are both retained and compared, and disagreement is recorded rather than assumed absent.

This bounded smoke loads no SAE weights. It records layer-16 activations and the declared aggregation only, and matches them against the structurally verified d_in of 4096; it does not select, rank, intervene on, or score any feature.

Execution device and dtype are executor facts recorded in the compute ledger, not part of the signed observation identity. Greedy generation upstream was already shown to be non-bit-reproducible across independent processes, so these activations attest to the retained response bytes rather than to a reproducible generation.
